messages:
Priya: FYI GCP Marketplace onboarding + NVIDIA channel partner need our security pack for the joint offering. They asked for SOC2 summary, a redacted penetration test executive summary, vendor questionnaire, and a hardware compatibility attestation. Can someone coordinate artifacts?
Ethan: I can coordinate. Do they require full auditor contacts or just the attestation page?
Nina: For GCP they want the attestation page + auditor letter. For NVIDIA partner portal, they also want a short note confirming we support GPU passthrough and GTSC drivers (no internal config).
Riley: I'll generate the hardware attestation. Need wording: "Redwood Inference confirms compatibility with NVIDIA A100 and H100 drivers in validated configurations." Want me to copy that?
Marcos: Yes, include supported driver versions and the validation date range. Also add that tuned quantization binaries are validated on those SKUs.
Priya: Legal: any NDA needed before sending the redacted pentest? @LegalBot?
LegalBot: Existing channel partnership NDA covers exchange of attestations only. For pentest executive summaries, send a redacted summary only (remove vuln IDs, IPs, client data). Do not share raw logs. Include a one-sentence attestation: "Raw test artifacts withheld per policy."
Ethan: Good. Timeline: I'll pull SOC2 attestation from s3 and paste a short redacted summary. Riley, can you produce the hardware attestation doc by tomorrow?
Riley: Yes. I'll use this snippet in a file: ```
Supported GPUs: NVIDIA A100 (v2,v3), H100
Supported Drivers: NVIDIA driver 525.x - 560.x (validated)
Validation window: 2025-07-01 to 2026-02-28
Notes: Quantized inference validated with cuBLAS/cuDNN tuned kernels.```
Nina: I'll update the vendor questionnaire (spreadsheet) with recent answers (encryption at rest, KMS, network segmentation, incident response). Source: /docs/marketplace/vendor_questionnaire_gcp_v2.xlsx
Ethan: Command I'm using to stage artifacts into secure bucket (internal only):
```
aws s3 cp SOC2_attestation_redacted.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/gcp-nvidia/1770456789/
aws s3 cp pentest_exec_summary_redacted.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/gcp-nvidia/1770456789/
aws s3 cp hardware_attestation.pdf s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/gcp-nvidia/1770456789/
```
OpsBot: Reminder: Files uploaded to s3://redwood-sec/marketplace/ are restricted to legal/compliance/partnerships. Do not share public presigned URLs.
Priya: Also planning a joint announcement with NVIDIA marketing after onboarding completes. Keep comms team in the loop.
Marcos: I'll ping NVIDIA PM to confirm acceptance criteria and ingestion method for the attestation.
Nina: Questionnaire and SOC summary will be ready by EOD tomorrow. Riley will deliver hardware attestation by noon.
Ethan: I'll coordinate upload and submit through GCP Marketplace portal once we have all artifacts. Estimated submission: 2026-03-27 16:00 PT.
Priya: Perfect. If anything blocks, escalate to me. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
